appearance.description: Hold out primary mesh assets; copies remain together. Training includes nose, wing, tail and cockpit. Tower has no validation instance; the only cockpit asset is training-only.

tower_category.description: Train on aircraft and hangars, validate on those categories, test towers separately from held-out appearances of seen categories.

hangar_instance.description: Same-primary-mesh location and assembly-context control, evaluated only on hangars; not appearance generalization.
